d: Golden-orange hair flows in long, voluminous waves with a side-parted fringe, adorned by a wreath of leaves and a small red fruit. Translucent, iridescent insect-like wings emerge from the back, and the figure holds a bundle of golden wheat and purple grapes. BODY COLOR: pale peach LEGS: plantigrade with five toes per foot
